create_datasetinfo_dataclass: create a DatasetInfo dataclass with dataset name, classes, input dimensions, and train/test sizes
build_regression_datasets: build a dictionary of regression datasets with metadata like boston_housing and concrete_strength
build_structured_datasets: build a dictionary of structured classification datasets including iris and german_credit_numeric
build_image_datasets: build a dictionary of image datasets including mnist, cifar10, and fashion_mnist
summarize_datatypes: summarize the DATASETS tuple containing all classification and regression dataset names
